definitions.explanation: The act of combining various elements into a unified whole, or an adjective-like use meaning comprehensive or all-encompassing.

examples.japanese: {総合|そうごう}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
{総合|そうごう}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had an examination at a general hospital.

examples.japanese: すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{総合|そうごう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{最終|さいしゅう}{的|てき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧な⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: We synthesized all opinions and reached a final conclusion.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly used as a prefix meaning "comprehensive" or "general" in compound words. Often paired with ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ to form the adjectival expression {総合|そうごう}{的|てき} (comprehensive, overall).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総合|そうごう}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ (general hospital)
- {総合|そうごう}{大学|だいがく} (comprehensive university)
- {総合|そうごう}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (comprehensively, overall)
- {総合|そうごう}{評価|ひょうか} (overall evaluation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{統合|とうごう}→統合：09615_tougou⟧: integration — bringing separate things into one system, whereas {総合|そうごう} emphasizes bringing together diverse elements for an overall view
